timezone.description: IANA time zone used to evaluate all schedules.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account ID, with or without the `act_` prefix.

windows.description: Weekday windows when the campaign must be `ACTIVE`, one entry per weekday. Outside every window it is `PAUSED`.

weekday.description: Weekday in the spec time zone.

from.description: Start of the window, inclusive, `HH:MM` in 24-hour time.

until.description: End of the window, exclusive, `HH:MM` in 24-hour time. `24:00` means end of day. Must be after `from`, so a window cannot cross midnight.
